head: codex/254-hosted-coverage-compile
title: CI: stop hosted coverage aggregate from recompiling Rust
body:
Closes #254

## Summary
- make the full hosted workspace coverage producer compile once and publish the authoritative workspace summary/provenance artifact
- convert `adl-coverage-hosted` into a light `ubuntu-latest` verification/merge gate instead of an Azure-heavy Rust coverage rerun
- update CI contract tests and workflow policy validation so aggregate Rust/toolchain/cache/profraw recompile paths fail the contract

## Validation
- `bash adl/tools/test_ci_runtime_contracts.sh` — PASS
- `bash adl/tools/test_ci_path_policy.sh` — PASS
- `ruby adl/tools/validate_ci_workflow_policy.rb` — PASS
- `git diff --check origin/main..HEAD` — PASS
- exact-head review at `402d605a546a93135dd6a9584b6d1ff801240cce` — PASS; review metadata recorded in typed SRP

## Non-claims
- No optional, cloud, paid, native, slow, soak, or spot validation jobs were dispatched.
- This does not change #199 runtime behavior or coverage thresholds.
- Remote GitHub CI remains the integration proof after publication.
